chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from him, عليه السلام, that he said:
"Pray and make it for what you missed."
ai.seo_question: Can a prayer be performed with the intention of making up a missed salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise ruling about performing a prayer and counting it toward a missed prayer. It relates to prayer rulings and indicates the intention of making the performed salat for what has been missed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1215 - Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"Pray and consider it for what you missed."
